name: Fog Cloud
description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The fog lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.
effect: Fog rolls in. In a fight: ranged attacks against you have disadvantage and you can slip away at will (Flee always works) for 10 rounds (concentration). On the road: +3 Thieving for 2 hours.
notes: In combat: ranged attacks against you have disadvantage, and Flee always succeeds, at any range. Concentration, 10 rounds.
Out of combat: +3 Thieving for 2 hours (sneaking past, sneaking away).
